library(TempleCBE)

# Introduction & Cohort Overview

This exploratory report provides standard quality diagnostics, missingness evaluations, baseline covariate tables stratified by group, and pairwise categorical association analyses adhering to the Center for Biostatistics & Epidemiology (CBE) clinical reporting guidelines.

```{r load-data}
# Load analysis data (demonstration uses TempleCBE benchmark data if no external data provided)
eda_data <- if (exists("cohort_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  get("cohort_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else {
  TempleCBE::tumor_wide |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      group = factor(ifelse(treatment == 1, "Active Therapy", "Control")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      site = factor(site),
      age = age,
      overall_survival = time,
      status = factor(ifelse(status == 1, "Event", "Censored"))
    )
}

strata_var <- "group"
```

## Data Structure & Quality Metrics

```{r tbl-data-intro}
#| label: tbl-data-intro
#| tbl-cap: "Data Attribute Summary & Completeness"

intro_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Attribute = c("Total Observations", "Total Variables", "Numeric Features", "Categorical Features"),
  Count = c(
    nrow(eda_data),
    ncol(eda_data),
    sum(vapply(eda_data, is.numeric, logical(1))),
    sum(vapply(eda_data, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x), logical(1)))
  )
)

knitr::kable(intro_summary, booktabs = TRUE)
```

# Missing Data Diagnostics

Evaluating patterns of missingness identifies features requiring imputation or sensitivity adjustments.

```{r fig-missing-data}
#| label: fig-missing-data
#| fig-cap: "Missing Data Proportion Across Cohort Features"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5

miss_obj <- TempleCBE::features_percent_miss(eda_data)
plot(miss_obj, add.label = TRUE)
```

\pagebreak

# Baseline Clinical Summary Tables

Baseline characteristics stratified by **`r strata_var`** are summarized below. Continuous variables are reported with means (standard deviations), medians (interquartile ranges), and ranges. Categorical features are reported with frequencies and percentages.

Categorical differences between groups are evaluated using **Central Fisher's Exact Test** with automatic mid-p adjustment when zero-cell margins occur, and Pearson's $\chi^2$ test when cell counts are adequate.

```{r tbl-baseline-summary}
#| label: tbl-baseline-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline Demographic and Clinical Characteristics by Group"

cont_vars <- names(eda_data)[vapply(eda_data, is.numeric, logical(1))]
cat_vars <- setdiff(names(eda_data)[vapply(eda_data, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x), logical(1))], strata_var)

# Continuous summary table
tbl_cont <- if (length(cont_vars) > 0) {
  eda_data |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(strata_var, cont_vars))) |>
    gtsummary::tbl_summary(
      by = dplyr::all_of(strata_var),
      type = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
      statistic = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ c(
        "{mean} ({sd})",
        "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
        "{median} ({min} \u2013 {max})"
      ),
      digits = gtsummary::everything() ~ 1,
      missing = "ifany"
    ) |>
    gtsummary::add_overall(last = TRUE, col_label = "**Overall**") |>
    gtsummary::add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ scales::pvalue(.x, accuracy = 0.001)) |>
    gtsummary::separate_p_footnotes()
} else {
  NULL
}

# Categorical summary table with CBE exact2x2 zero-cell mid-p test
tbl_cat <- if (length(cat_vars) > 0) {
  eda_data |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(strata_var, cat_vars))) |>
    gtsummary::tbl_summary(
      by = dplyr::all_of(strata_var),
      type = list(gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "categorical"),
      missing = "ifany"
    ) |>
    gtsummary::add_overall(last = TRUE, col_label = "**Overall**") |>
    gtsummary::add_p(
      test = gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ TempleCBE::cbe_test_categorical,
      pvalue_fun = ~ scales::pvalue(.x, accuracy = 0.001)
    ) |>
    gtsummary::separate_p_footnotes()
} else {
  NULL
}

# Combine and render
tbl_combined <- if (!is.null(tbl_cat) && !is.null(tbl_cont)) {
  gtsummary::tbl_stack(list(tbl_cat, tbl_cont))
} else if (!is.null(tbl_cat)) {
  tbl_cat
} else {
  tbl_cont
}

tbl_combined
```

\pagebreak

# Categorical Association Matrix & Pairwise Comparisons

The correlation between categorical predictors is evaluated using Cramér's V association coefficients and pairwise balloon contingency plots.

```{r fig-cat-association}
#| label: fig-cat-association
#| fig-cap: "Pairwise Categorical Association Matrix (Cram\u00e9r's V)"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 6

if (length(cat_vars) >= 2) {
  TempleCBE::plot_categorical_associations(
    data = eda_data,
    cols = c(strata_var, cat_vars),
    method = "cramer_v",
    title = "Categorical Covariate Association Matrix"
  )
}
```

## Pairwise Categorical Visualizations & Tests

Every pairwise combination of categorical factors can be evaluated below. Visualizations can be configured as balloon plots, proportional bar charts, mosaic plots, shaded heatmaps, or standard 4-quadrant square reports (q1 | q2 // q3 | q4 // p = pformat) using `TempleCBE::cbe_contingency_plot(type = "balloon" | "bar" | "mosaic" | "heatmap" | "square")`.

```{r setup-pairwise}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Selected plot style for pairwise categorical comparisons:
# Options: "balloon" (bubble frequencies), "bar" (proportional bar chart),
#          "mosaic" (area proportional), "heatmap" (shaded tiles),
#          or "square" (standard 4-quadrant report: q1 | q2 // q3 | q4 // p = pformat)
contingency_plot_type <- "balloon"

# Hypothesis test engine for pairwise comparisons:
# Options: "auto" (default CBE hierarchy: mid-p exact for 0-cells, exact for sparse, chisq for dense),
#          "chisq" (force Pearson Chi-squared test), "exact" (force exact test)
contingency_test_type <- "auto"

pairwise_combos <- TempleCBE::cbe_pairwise_combos(
  data = eda_data,
  cols = c(strata_var, cat_vars)
)
```

```{r render-pairwise-children}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

if (nrow(pairwise_combos) > 0) {
  child_template <- system.file("templates", "child_eda_chi_square.qmd", package = "TempleCBE")
  if (!nzchar(child_template) || !file.exists(child_template)) {
    child_template <- "child_eda_chi_square.qmd"
  }
  
  if (file.exists(child_template)) {
    src <- lapply(pairwise_combos$id, function(x) {
      knitr::knit_expand(child_template, x = x)
    })
    res <- knitr::knit_child(text = unlist(src), quiet = TRUE)
    cat(res, sep = "\n\n")
  }
}
```
